academic_intro: I studied Fashion Management, Communication and Media at Istituto Marangoni Milano, graduating in 2026 with a final grade of 110/110. Over three years, I explored the space between creativity, strategy, communication and design — here are some of the projects I created along the way.

academic_projects.title: The Power Is in Your Hands
academic_projects.subtitle: Final Thesis
academic_projects.description: An Apple 2035 concept bringing product innovation, luxury brand strategy, and a communication campaign together around the Apple Ring.

academic_projects.subtitle: Third-Year Project
academic_projects.description: An academic project developed during my third year at Istituto Marangoni Milano.

academic_projects.title: Circle of Life
academic_projects.subtitle: Third-Year Project
academic_projects.description: A third-year academic project exploring ideas through fashion, creativity, and communication.

academic_projects.subtitle: Second-Year Project
academic_projects.description: A business report studying the Czech advertising market, its industry landscape, and key players.

academic_projects.title: Loro Piana — The Roots Capsule Collection
academic_projects.subtitle: Second-Year Project
academic_projects.description: A capsule collection project combining Loro Piana brand analysis, collection development, and a marketing and launch strategy.

professional_projects.title: Zman Emet
professional_projects.subtitle: Investigative Documentary Series · Seasons 6–8
professional_projects.description: An investigative documentary series produced for KAN 11. During my three seasons with the show, multiple episodes I worked on received awards for Best Investigative Reporting.
professional_projects.responsibilities: I managed the post-production department and editing teams, coordinated between production stages, oversaw archive and footage licensing, and worked with the executive producer to deliver episodes aligned with the editorial vision.

professional_projects.title: Tiberias — Under the Red Line
professional_projects.subtitle: Five-Episode Documentary Series
professional_projects.description: A five-episode documentary series for KAN 11, recognized with the Israeli Best Documentary Show award for 2023.
professional_projects.responsibilities: I coordinated with the creator, director, technical teams and editors, managed editing schedules and archival research, and oversaw episode deliveries for broadcaster review and approval.
